exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
env TZ=UTC
exec card init --prefix sel-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: sel-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

# Creation flags establish priority, kind, labels, dependencies, and summary.
exec card create --priority 0 --type workstream --label program --summary 'Program context.' 'Program'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-program.txt
exec card create --priority 1 --type task --label docs,urgent --depends-on sel-1 --parent sel-1 --summary 'Child context.' 'Document system'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-document.txt
exec card create --label docs 'Independent task'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-independent.txt

exec card list --status ready --label docs --limit 1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/list.txt
exec card list --status ready --limit 0
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/list-unlimited.txt
exec card ready --limit 1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/ready.txt
! exec card ready --limit 0
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/ready-limit-error.txt
exec card blocked --limit 1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/blocked.txt
! exec card blocked --limit 0
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/blocked-limit-error.txt

exec card edit sel-2 --depends-on -sel-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/remove-dependency.txt
exec card edit sel-2 --depends-on sel-1 --label reviewed,-urgent
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/edit.txt
exec card --json show sel-2
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/edited.json

# Pull claiming honors label filters.
exec card --actor geordi claim --label docs
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/claim.txt

# A watched claim polls until another process creates a matching issue.
exec sh watch-claim.sh
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/watch-claim.txt

-- watch-claim.sh --
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
card --actor data claim --watch --label watched >claim.out 2>claim.err &
pid=$!
sleep 0.1
card create --label watched 'Watched task' >/dev/null
wait "$pid"
cat claim.out
cat claim.err >&2
